# Does It ARM

> Does It ARM catalogs reported Apple Silicon compatibility for Mac apps, games, Homebrew formulae, and audio plug-ins, with reference pages for Mac models.

Software listings are under `/app/`, `/game/`, and `/formula/` on https://doesitarm.com. They carry a reported status when available and may include per-device evidence, related links, and benchmark videos. Mac model reference pages are under `/device/`. A missing listing means compatibility is unknown from this catalog. An `unreported` status means native support has yet to be reported.

## MCP server

- [Does It ARM MCP server](https://mcp.doesitarm.com/mcp): check Apple Silicon compatibility for Mac apps, games, and Homebrew formulae. Public, read-only Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account. Tools: search_apps, get_app, check_apps, list_categories, list_by_category, recent_updates, list_devices, check_inventory (up to 250 rows from a Mac app inventory export, matched by bundle ID first).
- [Install guide](https://github.com/ThatGuySam/doesitarm/blob/master/docs/mcp.md): Claude Code `claude mcp add --transport http doesitarm https://mcp.doesitarm.com/mcp`

## Browse

- [Categories](https://doesitarm.com/categories/)
- [Audio plug-ins](https://doesitarm.com/audio-plugins/) — Scanned macOS architecture and format evidence by product, with verified host configurations where available.
- [Games](https://doesitarm.com/games/)
- [Homebrew](https://doesitarm.com/kind/homebrew)
- [Devices](https://doesitarm.com/devices)
- [Benchmarks](https://doesitarm.com/benchmarks)
- [Apple Silicon App Test](https://doesitarm.com/apple-silicon-app-test/)

## Services

- [Logic upgrade audit](https://doesitarm.com/services/studio-upgrade-audit/) — Scoped paid check of one Logic session and up to 15 plug-in versions for a Mac or macOS upgrade. Does It ARM is taking scope requests.
- [Old session rescue](https://doesitarm.com/services/audio-session-rescue/) — Waitlist for assessing what can be recovered from a copy of an older session that no longer opens.
